idea-plugin.name: Honey Style
idea-plugin.description:
Shows a color swatch next to honey-style theme color paths in JavaScript and TypeScript.

The palette is read from the project's own theme sources, so nothing is hardcoded: any colors, colors2 or palette object literal is flattened into dotted paths.

Recognised forms:

  • colors.primary.royalBlue and theme.colors.neutral.fogGrey
  • resolveColor('primary.royalBlue', 0.25) - alpha included in the swatch
  • getColor('primary.main') and getContrastColor(...)
  • any string literal that is a known path, e.g. $color="secondary.mediumGreen"
  • bare paths inside styled/css template literals, e.g. border-color: secondary.mediumGreen;

Cmd/Ctrl+Click on a path jumps to the declaration that holds the value, e.g. royalBlue: '#318BFA' in the theme file.

Completion of color paths shows the actual color as the item icon, in resolveColor('...') arguments and after a palette group such as colors.primary..

Honey at-rules are completed inside styled/css template literals - @honey-media, @honey-stack, @honey-inline, @honey-center, @honey-if, @honey-ellipsis and @honey-absolute-fill - along with their parameters. Breakpoint names for @honey-media are read from the project's theme.breakpoints.

The gutter color picker snaps to the nearest token in the palette instead of writing a raw hex value, since only theme tokens are valid in these positions.
